scenarios.scenario-1: An authorized legacy-scan provider produces warnings with file/line and an audit record.
scenarios.scenario-2: Untrusted or denied providers do not run and produce coded refusal/denial findings.
scenarios.scenario-3: Malformed provider JSON becomes LINT_PROVIDER_INVALID_OUTPUT, never a crash.

required-log-markers.marker-1: No runtime markers are emitted; tests assert findings, severity and audit-log JSONL.
